results.title: Mint 100 sat of ecash (quote → paid → mint)
Every signature comes with a valid DLEQ proof
Swap fee is exactly ceil(Σ input_fee_ppk / 1000)
results.detail: 3 inputs, fee 1 sat; overpay refused with HTTP 400 code 11005 (Transaction is not balanced) "Inputs: 10, Outputs: 10, expected_fee: 1. Transaction inputs should equal outputs less fee"

results.title: Spending the same proofs twice is refused with 11001
results.detail: HTTP 400 code 11001 (Proofs already spent) "Token Already Spent"

results.title: checkstate reports the spent proofs as SPENT
Melt pays an invoice; the unused fee reserve comes back as change
results.detail: invoice 5 sat, reserve 1, 8 in (input fee 1), 1 blank output(s) → change 2 sat; quote now PAID

results.title: Replaying the same swap within the TTL returns the cached signatures
results.detail: replay answered with the same signatures (ttl 60 s)

results.title: A mint quote locked to a pubkey mints only with its signature
results.detail: no signature: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "Signature missing or invalid"; wrong key: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "Signature missing or invalid"; right key: minted

results.title: P2PK: locked proofs need the key; with a signature they spend
results.detail: no witness: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "Witness signatures not provided. P2PK signatures are required but not provided"; wrong key: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "P2PK spend conditions are not met"; right key: spent (20008 is the NUT-20 mint-quote code; NUT-11 has none of its own)

results.title: P2PK 2-of-2: one signature refused, the same signature twice refused, two keys spend
results.detail: one signature: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "P2PK spend conditions are not met"; same one twice: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "P2PK spend conditions are not met"; both keys (in reverse order): spent

results.title: P2PK SIG_ALL: input-only signatures refused, signed outputs cannot be swapped, the right signature spends
results.detail: input-only signatures: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "P2PK spend conditions are not met"; outputs swapped after signing: HTTP 400 code 20008 (Signature for mint request invalid) "P2PK spend conditions are not met"; signed outputs: spent

results.title: HTLC: wrong preimage refused, right one spends, NUT-07 returns the witness
results.detail: wrong preimage: HTTP 400 code 50000 "Preimage does not match"; right: spent; checkstate witness carries the preimage

results.title: HTLC refund after locktime with the refund key alone
results.detail: signature-only refund witness refused: HTTP 400 code 50000 "Secret is not a HTLC secret". The same refund with "preimage": "" passes, so the mint parses a witness without "preimage" as P2PK (fixed in CDK main by cashubtc/cdk#2641).
